status: supplemental descriptive analytic plan; not part of stage44 primary outcomes
packet_error_definition: any received token ID differs from sent token in a fixed interleaved packet
population: all 100 images, 5 trials, 64 packets/reception at 8 dB
aggregation: pooled true packet errors / all 32000 packet trials; no strategy selection
assumptions: homogeneous independent retry approximation; actual retries not simulated
CRC failures are reported separately and are not substituted for true packet errors
no quality guarantee or complete-paper TCE curve claim
